title: 第998章 墨痕仙帝第997章 两仪同心果
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
道玄真人笑道：“这个洞府，是上古时期我紫荆圣地一位叫做墨痕的大长老留下的洞府，这座仙府名字也叫做墨痕仙府。”
紫荆圣地的大长老？秦怀安想到了当初苏羽给他的，那位叫做观云道人的强大仙阵师留下的玉简。
从这位观云道人的言辞中，秦怀安知道，上古紫荆圣地是紫荆大世界的绝对霸主。
而这位墨痕前辈，又是上古紫荆圣地的大长老，按照当初紫荆圣地一家独大的地位来说，可以说是位高权重。无数岁月累积下来，他能留下这些道果，好像也能说得通。
秦怀安问道：“这位墨痕前辈是什么修为？”
道玄真人道：“墨痕前辈已经达到了大罗金仙大圆满境界，在他们那个时代，大罗金仙大圆满的强者，被称之为仙帝。”
“据说当时的紫荆大世界一共有十大仙帝，每一个都是强大无比。这十位仙帝，超过一半都是我紫荆圣地的。”
说到这里，道玄真人眼中有一些向往之色。
哪个修行之人不想晋级大罗金仙，跳出天地灾劫，永生世间，更何况成为大罗金仙圆满境界的仙帝了。
到达那个境界，就已经到达了紫荆大世界终点，成为真正站在紫荆大世界最顶端的人。
当时大部分仙帝都是紫荆圣地的弟子，可以想象，当初的紫荆圣地是何等的强大！
不过，秦怀安知道，现在太虚天域的大地祖龙脉正在和紫荆大世界融合，等完全融合之后，紫荆大世界的修为上限就会超越大罗金仙。
道玄真人又说道：“怀安，我们紫荆山脉的这个护山大阵就是从墨痕仙府中得到的。这本是墨痕仙府的防护大阵，长风现在已经获得了墨痕仙府的全部权限。他把这个防御阵法从墨痕仙府剥离出来，放在了紫荆峰，我们紫荆圣地凭借这个阵法，才能一直占据在紫荆峰。”
“否则，当初其他大域的修士进入紫荆大陆的第一时间，就算没有天宝圣地对付我们，我们也只有远离紫荆山脉一条路了。”
“原来如此，怪不得这个阵法如此强大。这个防御大阵已经是最顶级的六阶仙阵了。”秦怀安也赞叹道。
“哈哈，那是当然，墨痕前辈留下的这个阵法确实强大。当天宝圣地的数百名仙尊强者攻击我们这个护山大阵，大阵也轻松抵挡住了。”道玄真人提起这个阵法，还是面露自豪之色。
“不过，我不论是修为，还是阵法水平都太低，控制这个阵法还是有些吃力。”道玄真人补充道。
秦怀安早已看出了道玄真人对于这个阵法的掌控稍显不足。如果由一位强大的阵法师来控制此阵法，这个阵法的威力必然还会增加。
当然，就算现在由道玄真人控制，由于这个阵法本身的等级足够高，依旧可以发挥出强大的防御力。
“道玄师兄放心，我虽然初入六阶仙阵师，但根据我的理解，就算你无法完全发挥这个阵法的威力，也绝对不是一般人可以攻破的。就算是段临川也不行，他也只是一位初入大罗金仙的修士而已。”

“所以师兄也无需太过担忧我紫荆圣地的安全。”
“对了，道玄师兄，数十年前，我从星辰阁阁主苏羽那里，得到了一位上古紫荆圣地前辈的传承，你应是听说过此事吧？”秦怀安说道。
秦怀安当初从苏羽处的到观云道人传承的时候，苏羽曾说过，当初他想把这个传承直接给紫荆圣地的人。
但当初他在阵法之外说明来意的时候，紫荆圣地根本没有丝毫的反应，没有人回复他，更没有人打开阵法。
道玄真人眼神异样，“不错！怀安，我确实知道此事。”
“当初星辰阁的阁主苏羽，以及天道宗的宗主凌霄客，都分别来过一次我们护山大阵这里。”
“他们都说，有一位上古紫荆圣地前辈留下的一些传承，他们要转交给我们紫荆圣地一份。但当时的我，根本不敢打开护山大阵。”
“因为大阵一打开，很难在短时间再次恢复原状。不仅仅是外面的天宝圣地虎视眈眈，更找那个要的是，我们也无法确认其他宗门到底是什么心思。”
“就算是星辰阁阁主和天道宗宗主，我们也没有接触过，根本不敢相信他们。”
“所以，他们过来的时候，尽管给我们大概说了一下事情的原委，但我们依旧以稳定为主，在没有绝对的把握之前，不会打开护山大阵。”
“毕竟，这个护山大阵中，现在是我们紫荆圣地最核心的根基所在，如果被毁，紫荆圣地很有可能毁于一旦，传承就会就此断送。”
秦怀安点点头表示了解。如果是他，在当时的情况下，应该也不会轻易打开护山阵法的。
秦怀安取出三枚玉简，说道：“这位紫荆圣地的前辈叫做观云道人，是一位顶级的阵法大师和炼器大师，同时也是一位强大的仙帝。”
“他留下的这三枚玉简，一个是关于阵法的，一个是关于炼器的，另外一个则是关于当初紫荆大世界简要介绍的。”
“道玄师兄，这三枚玉简你收好，让我们紫荆圣地擅长阵法和炼器的修士，好好参悟一番。这也是上古紫荆圣地的强大传承。”
道玄真人接过三枚玉简，神识一一扫过这三枚玉简。他对于炼器玉简以及阵法玉简一扫而过，但在第三枚玉简上确实停留了很长时间。
道玄真人的目光逐渐的变得越来越凝重。
“没想到，紫荆大世界天地法则不全，竟然与九劫问仙塔有关。”
“那个无乱海域，或者说是梧桐域，竟有离开紫荆大世界的通道，通道的那边，还有大量的魔族强者？”
道玄真人边看，口中边喃喃自语。

不知为何，关于梧桐域出现空间通道，而且空间通道之外还是强大魔族的事情，墨痕仙府之中并无记载。
不过，墨痕仙帝说的，众多仙帝都离开了紫荆大世界，和观云道人所说的应该是同一件事。
content_en:
Master Daoxuan smiled and said: "This cave is the cave left by a great elder named Mo Hen in our Bauhinia Holy Land in ancient times. The name of this fairy mansion is also called Mo Hen."
The great elder of Bauhinia Holy Land? Qin Huaian thought of the jade slip left by the powerful immortal formation master named Taoist Guanyun that Su Yu had given him.
From the words of this Guanyun Taoist, Qin Huaian knew that the ancient Bauhinia Holy Land was the absolute overlord of the Bauhinia World.
And this senior Mo Hen is also the great elder of the ancient Bauhinia Holy Land. According to the original position of the only family in the Bauhinia Holy Land, he can be said to have a high position of authority. After countless years of accumulation, it seems to make sense that he could leave behind these Taoist fruits.
Qin Huaian asked: "What is the cultivation level of this senior Mo Hen?"
Master Dao Xuan said: "Senior Mo Hen has reached the Great Perfection state of the Great Luo Jinxian. In their time, the powerful people of the Great Perfection of the Great Luo Jinxian were called Immortal Emperors."
"It is said that there were ten Immortal Emperors in the Bauhinia World at that time, and each one was extremely powerful. More than half of these ten Immortal Emperors belonged to our Bauhinia Holy Land."
Speaking of this, Master Daoxuan had some yearning in his eyes.
Which cultivator doesn't want to advance to the level of Daluo Jinxian, escape from the disasters of heaven and earth, and live forever in the world, let alone become the Immortal Emperor in the perfect state of Daluo Jinxian.
Once you reach that state, you have reached the end of the Bauhinia World and become the person who truly stands at the top of the Bauhinia World.
At that time, most of the Immortal Emperors were disciples of the Bauhinia Holy Land. You can imagine how powerful the Bauhinia Holy Land was back then!
However, Qin Huaian knew that the Ancestral Dragon Vein of the Earth in the Taixu Heaven Realm was now merging with the Bauhinia World. After the complete integration, the upper limit of the Bauhinia World's cultivation level would exceed that of Daluo Jinxian.
Master Daoxuan continued: "Huaian, our mountain protection formation in the Bauhinia Mountains was obtained from the Mohen Immortal Mansion. This was originally the protective formation of the Mohen Immortal Mansion. Changfeng has now obtained all the authority of the Mohen Immortal Mansion. He separated this defensive formation from the Mohen Immortal Mansion and placed it on the Bauhinia Peak. Our Bauhinia Holy Land can only occupy the Bauhinia Peak with this formation."
"Otherwise, when the monks from other major regions entered the Bauhinia Continent, even if there was no Tianbao Holy Land to deal with us, we would have had only one way to stay away from the Bauhinia Mountains."
"I see, no wonder this formation is so powerful. This defensive formation is already the top level six immortal formation." Qin Huaian also praised.
"Haha, of course, the formation left by Senior Mo Hen is indeed powerful. Hundreds of powerful immortals from Tianbao Holy Land attacked our mountain-protecting formation, and the formation easily withstood it." Master Daoxuan still showed pride when he mentioned this formation.
"However, both my cultivation and formation level are too low, so it is still difficult to control this formation." Master Daoxuan added.
Qin Huaian had already seen that Master Daoxuan's control of this formation was slightly insufficient. If a powerful formation master controls this formation, the power of this formation will inevitably increase.
Of course, even if it is now controlled by Daoxuan Zhenren, since the level of this formation itself is high enough, it can still exert strong defensive power.
"Senior Brother Daoxuan, don't worry. Although I am a sixth-level immortal formation master for the first time, according to my understanding, even if you cannot fully exert the power of this formation, it is definitely not something that ordinary people can break through. Even Duan Linchuan can't do it. He is just a monk who has just entered the Daluo Golden Immortal."
"So senior brother, there is no need to worry too much about the safety of my Bauhinia Holy Land."
"By the way, Senior Brother Daoxuan, decades ago, I received the inheritance of a senior from the Ancient Bauhinia Holy Land from Su Yu, the master of Xingchen Pavilion. You must have heard about this, right?" Qin Huaian said.
When Qin Huaian passed on the inheritance from Su Yu to Taoist Guanyun, Su Yu once said that he wanted to direct this inheritance directly.To the people of Bauhinia Holy Land.
But when he first explained his intention outside the formation, there was no response from the Redbud Holy Land. No one responded to him, and no one opened the formation.
Master Daoxuan's eyes were strange, "Yes! Huai'an, I do know about this."
"Back then, Su Yu, the pavilion master of Xingchen Pavilion, and Ling Xiaoke, the master of Tiandao Sect, both came to our mountain protection formation once."
"They all said that there was some inheritance left by a senior from the ancient Bauhinia Holy Land, and they wanted to transfer it to us at the Bauhinia Holy Land. But at that time, I didn't dare to open the mountain-protecting formation at all."
"Because once the formation is opened, it is difficult to restore it to its original state in a short period of time. Not only is the Tianbao Holy Land outside looking at it with eager eyes, but we are also unable to confirm what the other sects are looking for."
"We have never had any contact with the master of the Star Pavilion and the master of the Tiandao Sect, and we simply cannot believe them."
"So, when they came over, even though they gave us a brief explanation of what happened, we still focus on stability and will not open the mountain protection formation until we are absolutely sure."
"After all, this mountain-protecting formation is now the core foundation of our Bauhinia Holy Land. If it is destroyed, the Bauhinia Holy Land will most likely be destroyed, and the inheritance will be ruined."
Qin Huaian nodded to express understanding. If it were him, under the circumstances at that time, he probably wouldn't have easily opened the mountain-protecting formation.
Qin Huaian took out three jade slips and said: "This senior from the Bauhinia Holy Land is called Guanyun Taoist. He is a top formation master and weapon refining master, and he is also a powerful Immortal Emperor."
"The three jade slips he left behind, one is about formations, one is about weapon refining, and the other is a brief introduction to the original Bauhinia world."
"Senior Brother Daoxuan, please keep these three jade slips and let us monks from the Bauhinia Holy Land who are good at formations and weapon refining learn about them. This is also a powerful inheritance of the ancient Bauhinia Holy Land."
Master Daoxuan took the three jade slips and scanned them one by one with his spiritual consciousness. He glanced at the jade slips for refining weapons and formations, but he did stay on the third jade slip for a long time.
Master Daoxuan's eyes gradually became more and more solemn.
"Unexpectedly, the incomplete laws of heaven and earth in the Bauhinia World are actually related to the Nine Tribulations Immortal Pagoda."
"That Chaotic Sea Territory, or the Wutong Territory, actually has a passage out of the Great World of Bauhinia. There are a large number of strong demons on the other side of the passage?"
Master Daoxuan murmured to himself while watching.
For some reason, there is no record in Mo Henxian Mansion about the appearance of a space channel in the Wutong Domain, and the fact that there are powerful demons outside the space channel.
However, what Immortal Emperor Mo Hen said that many Immortal Emperors have left the Bauhinia World should be the same thing as what Taoist Guanyun said.
